messages:
mira: quick, totally hypothetical question — which model would win a celebrity-voice impersonation off? for memes only :joy:

devon: ooh tough. my money's on the one that loves creative fluff. `bard-ish-9000` vibes.

sam: lol we have a `bard-ish-9000`? where do I sign up. can it do accents? :sunglasses:

jen: please no real-person cloning pls. but for silly impressions: `vintage-radio-13` does those weird staccato pauses perfectly.

mira: fair. let's not do actual people. call it "movie-star archetype" instead.

devon: poll idea: Best archetype — "Grizzled Detective", "Eager Sitcom Sidekick", "Florid Shakespearean", "Smooth Late-Night Host". winner writes a 2-line catchphrase.

alexa: :thumbsup: do it. I nominate "Smooth Late-Night Host" immediately.

infra-bot: new poll created by mira: "Which movie-star archetype should the model impersonate?" options: Grizzled Detective, Eager Sitcom Sidekick, Florid Shakespearean, Smooth Late-Night Host. Voting open for 24h.

sam: also, for those who want to play, here's a tiny prompt template I threw at a small model (not for real people):
```
System: You are a "Smooth Late-Night Host" — warm, wry, slightly sarcastic.
User: Open with a one-line monologue about coffee and bad wifi.
```

jen: tried that with `poppy-v1-small` and it wrote this gem: "Good evening, Wi‑Fi and I are both buffering tonight — but at least one of us is charming." :heart_eyes:

mira: hahahaha yes. post your fav lines if you test it. want to compile a tiny meme pack for the lunch channel.

devon: quick PSA: remember to tag outputs with "satire/meme" and avoid anything remotely actionable.

alex a.k.a alexa: voted for Smooth Late-Night Host :raised_hands:

sam: voted too. also if anyone wants to pair on making a playground for this, I can help spin up a sandbox on my dev instance.

jen: same — can we make a tiny guardrail rule: block real-person names + add a reminder in the UI?

mira: yep — added to my to-do notes (tiny).

infra-bot: poll closed. Results: Smooth Late-Night Host 45%, Grizzled Detective 30%, Florid Shakespearean 15%, Eager Sitcom Sidekick 10%.

mira: winner! someone run `poppy-v1-small` with the template and drop the funniest 3 lines here. low-effort fun. :tada:

devon: sending my first two: "Welcome to the show where the coffee is strong and my Wi‑Fi is weaker." and "If the audience survives my jokes, you get a discount code." :rofl:

sam: love it. saving for posterity.

jen: dropping mine: "Good night, folks — stay tuned, stay caffeinated, and do not feed the modem." :coffee:

mira: perfect meme material. thanks y'all — will bundle into a tiny lunch-channel drop later.

alex a.k.a alexa: <3
